const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

BASE = "281ad0eff272259bf8c0bf67670c35a0ba7b7353"
LUA = r'''
local records = {}
local current_section = ""
function section(s) current_section = s end
function t(...)
  local n = select("#", ...)
  local rec = {current_section, tostring(n)}
  for i = 1, n do
    local value = select(i, ...)
    rec[#rec + 1] = type(value)
    rec[#rec + 1] = tostring(value)
  end
  records[#records + 1] = rec
end
local source = io.read("*a")
local chunk, err = loadstring(source, "@mod-tome.lua")
assert(chunk, err)
chunk()
local function put(value)
  value = tostring(value)
  io.write(#value, ":", value)
end
put(#records)
for _, rec in ipairs(records) do
  put(#rec)
  for _, value in ipairs(rec) do put(value) end
end
'''

def git_show(path):
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{path}"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE
    ).stdout

def parse_token(blob, pos):
    colon = blob.index(b":", pos)
    size = int(blob[pos:colon])
    start = colon + 1
    end = start + size
    return blob[start:end].decode("utf-8"), end

def load_lua(blob):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    root = env["TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT"]
    env["LUA_PATH"] = f"{root}/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;{root}/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;"
    env["LUA_CPATH"] = f"{root}/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;"
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [env["TOME_LUAJIT"], "-e", LUA], input=blob, check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env,
    )
    count_s, pos = parse_token(proc.stdout, 0)
    records = []
    for _ in range(int(count_s)):
        width_s, pos = parse_token(proc.stdout, pos)
        rec = []
        for _ in range(int(width_s)):
            value, pos = parse_token(proc.stdout, pos)
            rec.append(value)
        records.append(tuple(rec))
    assert pos == len(proc.stdout)
    return records

baseline_records = load_lua(git_show("mod-tome.lua"))
current_records = load_lua(Path("mod-tome.lua").read_bytes())
assert len(baseline_records) == len(current_records)
changes = []
for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(baseline_records, current_records), 1):
    if before == after:
        continue
    assert before[0] == after[0]
    assert before[1] == after[1] == "3"
    # Layout: section, argc, type1, value1, type2, value2, type3, value3
    assert before[2:5] == after[2:5]
    assert before[6:] == after[6:]
    changes.append({
        "record_index": index,
        "section": before[0],
        "source": before[3],
        "source_tag": before[7],
        "before": before[5],
        "after": after[5],
    })

expected_pairs = {
    ("深岩形态", "深岩"),
    ("当你进入深岩元素形态时，你获得 %d%% 流血、毒素、疾病和震慑免疫。\n\t\t技能等级 5 或以上时，在深岩元素形态下，你将用物理抗性取代其他伤害抗性。",
     "当你进入深岩元素形态时，你获得 %d%% 流血、毒素、疾病和震慑免疫。\n\t\t技能等级 5 或以上时，在深岩形态下，你将用物理抗性取代其他伤害抗性。"),
    ("#{bold}#巫医库贝克的实验笔记：一#{normal}#\n\n复兴我们的种族——我接下的是多么可怕而悲惨的使命。那群猪猡般的人类与半身人彻底摧毁了我们的整个社会，只剩下军方的粗鄙武夫来统治我们的人民。我们仅剩下寥寥几名女性，若不采取极端手段，我们很快便将灭绝。\n\n而这些极端手段全系于我一身。在我们的聚居地被彻底抹杀之前，我便已撤退至远东，因此我是现存唯一掌握高深医术的兽人。我必须寻得一种方法来延长残存雌性的寿命，并让她们以极快的速度繁衍后代。我将动用我所能支配的一切自然与魔法手段。\n\n我将这处远离主营地的洞穴辟为秘密据点。我必须在此行见不得光的黑暗之举，而我希望这一切永远不为人知……",
     "#{bold}#巫医库贝克的实验笔记，第一部分#{normal}#\n\n复兴我们的种族——我接下的是多么可怕而悲惨的使命。那群猪猡般的人类与半身人彻底摧毁了我们的整个社会，只剩下军方的粗鄙武夫来统治我们的人民。我们仅剩下寥寥几名女性，若不采取极端手段，我们很快便将灭绝。\n\n而这些极端手段全系于我一身。在我们的聚居地被彻底抹杀之前，我便已撤退至远东，因此我是现存唯一掌握高深医术的兽人。我必须寻得一种方法来延长残存雌性的寿命，并让她们以极快的速度繁衍后代。我将动用我所能支配的一切自然与魔法手段。\n\n我将这处远离主营地的洞穴辟为秘密据点。我必须在此行见不得光的黑暗之举，而我希望这一切永远不为人知……"),
}
# The four lore pairs are checked by exact prefix replacement plus invariant remainder.
assert len(changes) == 6
assert any((c["before"], c["after"]) == ("深岩形态", "深岩") for c in changes)
for numeral, part in (("一", "第一部分"), ("二", "第二部分"), ("三", "第三部分"), ("四", "第四部分")):
    candidates = [c for c in changes if c["before"].startswith(f"#{{bold}}#巫医库贝克的实验笔记：{numeral}#{{normal}}#")]
    assert len(candidates) == 1
    c = candidates[0]
    old_prefix = f"#{{bold}}#巫医库贝克的实验笔记：{numeral}#{{normal}}#"
    new_prefix = f"#{{bold}}#巫医库贝克的实验笔记，{part}#{{normal}}#"
    assert c["after"] == new_prefix + c["before"][len(old_prefix):]
spell = [c for c in changes if c["source"].startswith("While in deeprock form,")]
assert len(spell) == 1
assert spell[0]["before"].splitlines()[0] == spell[0]["after"].splitlines()[0]
assert spell[0]["after"] == spell[0]["before"].replace("在深岩元素形态下", "在深岩形态下")

term_edits = json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w60-20261001/TERM-EDITS.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
baseline_term = git_show("terminology/talents.tsv")
current_term = Path("terminology/talents.tsv").read_bytes()
assert b"\r" not in baseline_term and b"\r" not in current_term
assert baseline_term.endswith(b"\n") and current_term.endswith(b"\n")
lines = baseline_term.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
insert = term_edits[0]
replace = term_edits[1]
assert lines.count(insert["insert_before"]) == 1
insert_at = lines.index(insert["insert_before"])
lines.insert(insert_at, insert["new"])
assert lines.count(replace["old"]) == 1
replace_at = lines.index(replace["old"])
lines[replace_at] = replace["new"]
expected_term = ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
assert current_term == expected_term

print(f"PASS LuaJIT loaded baseline/current: {len(current_records)} records")
print(f"PASS changed targets: {len(changes)}; all other records/fields identical")
for c in changes:
    before_head = c["before"].splitlines()[0]
    after_head = c["after"].splitlines()[0]
    if before_head == after_head and len(c["before"].splitlines()) > 1:
        before_head = c["before"].splitlines()[1]
        after_head = c["after"].splitlines()[1]
    print(f"  {c['section']} [{c['source_tag']}]: {before_head} -> {after_head}")
print("PASS terminology/talents.tsv: exactly 1 insertion + 1 replacement; LF/TAB bytes otherwise identical; final newline preserved")

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

BASE = "281ad0eff272259bf8c0bf67670c35a0ba7b7353"
LUA = r'''
local records = {}
local current_section = ""
local function stable(value, seen)
  local kind = type(value)
  if kind ~= "table" then return tostring(value) end
  seen = seen or {}
  if seen[value] then return "<cycle>" end
  seen[value] = true
  local parts = {}
  for key, item in pairs(value) do
    parts[#parts + 1] = stable(key, seen) .. "=" .. stable(item, seen)
  end
  table.sort(parts)
  seen[value] = nil
  return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}"
end
function section(s) current_section = s end
function t(...)
  local n = select("#", ...)
  local rec = {current_section, tostring(n)}
  for i = 1, n do
    local value = select(i, ...)
    rec[#rec + 1] = type(value)
    rec[#rec + 1] = stable(value)
  end
  records[#records + 1] = rec
end
local chunk, err = loadstring(io.read("*a"), "@mod-tome.lua")
assert(chunk, err)
chunk()
local function put(value)
  value = tostring(value)
  io.write(#value, ":", value)
end
put(#records)
for _, rec in ipairs(records) do
  put(#rec)
  for _, value in ipairs(rec) do put(value) end
end
'''

def git_show(path):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{path}"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout

def token(blob, pos):
    colon = blob.index(b":", pos)
    size = int(blob[pos:colon])
    start = colon + 1
    end = start + size
    return blob[start:end].decode("utf-8"), end

def load_lua(blob):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    root = env["TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT"]
    env["LUA_PATH"] = f"{root}/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;{root}/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;"
    env["LUA_CPATH"] = f"{root}/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;"
    proc = subprocess.run([env["TOME_LUAJIT"], "-e", LUA], input=blob, check=True,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
    count, pos = token(proc.stdout, 0)
    records = []
    for _ in range(int(count)):
        width, pos = token(proc.stdout, pos)
        rec = []
        for _ in range(int(width)):
            value, pos = token(proc.stdout, pos)
            rec.append(value)
        records.append(tuple(rec))
    assert pos == len(proc.stdout)
    return records

baseline_records = load_lua(git_show("mod-tome.lua"))
current_records = load_lua(Path("mod-tome.lua").read_bytes())
assert len(baseline_records) == len(current_records)
changes = []
for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(baseline_records, current_records), 1):
    if before == after:
        continue
    assert len(before) == len(after)
    differing_fields = [i for i, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(before, after)) if left != right]
    assert differing_fields == [5], (index, differing_fields)
    changes.append({
        "record_index": index,
        "section": before[0],
        "source": before[3],
        "source_tag": before[7],
        "before": before[5],
        "after": after[5],
    })

workset = json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w60-20261001/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
expected = {}
parts = {"one": ("一", "第一部分"), "two": ("二", "第二部分"),
         "three": ("三", "第三部分"), "four": ("四", "第四部分")}
for item in workset:
    key = (item["section"], item["source"], item["source_tag"])
    before = item["target_preimage"]
    if item["source"] == "deeprock":
        after = "深岩"
    elif item["source"].startswith("While in deeprock form,"):
        after = before.replace("在深岩元素形态下", "在深岩形态下")
        assert after.splitlines()[0] == before.splitlines()[0]
    else:
        word = next(word for word in parts if f"part {word}" in item["source"].splitlines()[0])
        numeral, label = parts[word]
        old = f"巫医库贝克的实验笔记：{numeral}"
        new = f"巫医库贝克的实验笔记，{label}"
        assert before.count(old) == 1
        after = before.replace(old, new)
    expected[key] = (before, after)
actual = {(c["section"], c["source"], c["source_tag"]): (c["before"], c["after"]) for c in changes}
assert actual == expected
assert len(changes) == 6

term_edits = json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w60-20261001/TERM-EDITS.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
baseline_term = git_show("terminology/talents.tsv")
current_term = Path("terminology/talents.tsv").read_bytes()
assert b"\r" not in baseline_term and b"\r" not in current_term
assert baseline_term.endswith(b"\n") and current_term.endswith(b"\n")
lines = baseline_term.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
insert, replace = term_edits
assert lines.count(insert["insert_before"]) == 1
lines.insert(lines.index(insert["insert_before"]), insert["new"])
assert lines.count(replace["old"]) == 1
lines[lines.index(replace["old"])] = replace["new"]
assert current_term == ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
assert all(line.count("\t") == 7 for line in (insert["new"], replace["new"]))

print(f"PASS LuaJIT loaded baseline/current: {len(current_records)} records")
print("PASS mod-tome.lua: exactly 6 targets changed; section/source/source_tag/args and all other records identical")
for c in changes:
    old_lines = c["before"].splitlines()
    new_lines = c["after"].splitlines()
    line_no = next(i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(old_lines, new_lines)) if a != b)
    print(f"  {c['section']}: {old_lines[line_no]} -> {new_lines[line_no]}")
print("PASS terminology/talents.tsv: exactly 1 insertion + 1 replacement; all other bytes identical")
print("PASS terminology/talents.tsv: LF-only, 8 TSV fields on new lines, final newline preserved")
